name: Bellingshauseniga Arktikas: Loodeväil
overview: The sailing ship Admiral Bellingshausen sets off from Sillamäe Harbour towards the Arctic to take the Estonian flag as close to the North Pole as possible. On the one hand, the team is faced with anticipation for the exotic polar regions; on the other hand, they are fearful since they are embarking on this adventure in the conditions of the pandemic. Expedition leader and host Tiit Pruuli; director and operator Christian Johannes Kask.
